rationale.faithfulness: HH385's Langevin saturation fails its pre-set kill with power >= 0.87 in every scored unit: the line fits as well out of fold (bge pool -9.0 [-17.2, -2.2]) and the step curve is flat. The synthetic check found a real flaw in the card's design (call effects do not hold the per-read slope) and A1 fixed it before data. C 0, D 0, E 0, F 2, H 0.
rationale.usefulness: A usable negative for operators: repeating a point in one batch does not add pull; the newest message is the only directional lever (+0.010 per direction on #51).
